ambient: Another flight. Your legs report in slightly closer than before.
Something you had put down a long way below is handed up to you.
The light at the top gets fractionally less theoretical.
description: Stairs, going up, and a great many of them. You are climbing out of something and it is taking most of an evening. Your body is coming back to you a piece at a time and each piece is heavier than you remember agreeing to.
name: The Long Way Back Up

looks: Many. Even. Going up out of it.
You have done a lot of them and there are a lot of them.
They are getting easier, which is how you know.
objects.name: the stairs

looks: A hand. Then the other. They are handed over properly.
Weight returns to you in instalments and you sign for each.
The half-second gap is down to a quarter. You will miss it.
objects.name: the pieces coming back

weather: It gets fractionally less close with every flight, which is how you know you are getting out.
